data.name: secure.nested.detail

data.name: setup.firstPage.title
data.value: Welcome to Compendio

data.name: setup.firstPage.body
data.value:
This page is a real file on disk. Open the content folder and you will find it as Markdown, exactly as you see it here.
Some things worth trying:
- Edit this page with the button above. You never have to type Markdown. - Create a folder for each area — IT, HR, Procedures — and pages inside it. - Restrict a folder from the Access screen when only some people should see it.
Delete this page when you no longer need it.

data.name: ai.provider_error.title

data.name: ai.provider_error.detail
data.value: The AI endpoint returned an error ({0}). Nothing was changed. An administrator can check the connection under Administration, Integrations.

data.name: ai.timeout.title
data.value: The AI provider took too long

data.name: ai.timeout.detail
data.value: {0} did not answer in time. Nothing was changed. A local model on a busy machine can simply be slow; try again, or try a shorter selection.

data.name: ai.not_allowed_here.title
data.value: AI is not allowed on this page

data.name: ai.not_allowed_here.detail
data.value: "{0}" is in a space the AI assistant may not read. Encrypted folders are excluded until an administrator opts them in, having been told which endpoint their contents would be sent to.

data.name: ai.quota_exceeded.title
data.value: You have used your AI allowance for today

data.name: ai.quota_exceeded.detail
data.value: You have made {0} AI requests in the last 24 hours, which is the limit an administrator set for each person. Nothing was changed. Your allowance frees up as your earlier requests age out of the 24-hour window. Everything else in the wiki works normally.

data.name: ai.quota_exceeded_instance.title
data.value: This wiki has used its AI allowance for today

data.name: ai.quota_exceeded_instance.detail
data.value: Everyone together has made {0} AI requests in the last 24 hours, which is the limit set for this instance. Nothing was changed, and this is not about anything you did. It frees up as earlier requests age out of the 24-hour window; an administrator can raise the limit under Administration, Integrations.
